Cinematic view of an opulent Victorian private gentlemen's card club table surface. The central field is rich, tactile dark forest green and deep emerald velvet felt baize with fine fabric weave texture. Surrounding the perimeter is a polished dark carved mahogany wood border inlaid with tarnished antique brass and gold filigree, featuring delicate Victorian playing card suit motifs (spades, hearts, clubs, diamonds) subtly etched into the filigree corner accents. Soft, warm amber glow from off-frame candlelight and a banker's brass desk lamp casts a gentle warm rim light along the wooden frame and outer edges, creating a luxurious chiaroscuro ambience. The center of the frame is cast in deep, moody, dark vignette shadows—calm, clean, uncluttered negative space with no objects, no cards, no text, no letters, and no numbers, perfectly clear for UI overlay. Photorealistic, tactile material realism, atmospheric 19th-century private parlor aesthetic, rich cinematic depth.
